title: Flexible and Stable Dynamics Discovery with Onsager's Variational Principle
summary: Variational principles specify the dynamics of a physical system via the extremization of associated functional data. Onsager's variational principle (OVP), which characterizes dissipation-dominated phenomena such as phase separation, admits an unconditionally energy-stable time discretization through the minimization of a Rayleighan functional combining free energy and dissipative effects. The present work considers the case where one or more parts of this functional are empirically approximated or otherwise uncertain. To address this, a novel variational discretization of OVP is introduced…
